# TDEE calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/tdee/

Explore adult daily energy expenditure with an editable activity multiplier. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Apply a physical activity level of 1.55 to an estimated resting-energy value.

## Limits and checks

The activity multiplier is an assumption. This tool is not intended for pregnancy, children, illness or individual treatment.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.

## Method and sources

- [Mifflin et al. — resting energy equation](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2305711/)
- [FAO/WHO/UNU — adult energy requirements and PAL](https://www.fao.org/4/Y5686e/y5686e07.htm)
